title: Raspberry & Cinnamon Baked Oats with Toasted Almond Topping
description: Baked oats mixed with egg, Greek yogurt, cinnamon and raspberries, topped with flaked almonds and baked in ramekins.
steps: Mix together oats, baking powder, cinnamon, sweetener and a small pinch of salt. Crack in the egg and spoon in the yogurt, then mix everything together well.
Stir the raspberries through the oat mixture.
Spray 2 ramekins with cooking spray and divide the mixture evenly between them.
Sprinkle flaked almonds evenly over the top, spray with cooking spray, then bake on the middle shelf for 35 minutes.
Serve straightaway in the ramekins with fresh raspberries and fat-free yogurt on the side.
notes: Works with blueberries, blackberries or frozen mixed berries. Replace cinnamon with vanilla extract for variety. Dry mix can be prepped the night before.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
